notes.title: Introducing Deadlock Station
notes.content:
[h3]O Ironlords, it’s time to sortie![/h3]

Warriors from another world need your help to rebuild their ruined civilization and defend it from a relentless horde. From the job description you’re looking to be exactly what we need.

[previewyoutube=X4slrSi6qBI;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327640/Deadlock_Station/

Introducing [i]Deadlock Station[/i]: an auto-battler that will put your strategizing skills to the test.

[list]
[*] [b]Manage Your Survival:[/b] The outcome of a battle is pre-determined based on your decisions. Will you handle all the variables of a war-torn world?
[*] [b]Prosper Amidst Destruction[/b]: Expand your outposts with each expedition into the wilds and unlock items, characters, and factions to interact with, with no two journeys feeling alike. What will be your vision for the future?
[*] [b]Use the Environment[/b]: The battlefield is your prime resource: construct spiked walls, establish choke points amidst city ruins, bait enemies into traps, and push them onto hazards. Will your cunning be enough?
[*] [b]Know Your Friend and Foe[/b]: Command your own squad, learn and channel their abilities, and supplant them with upgrades and gear, including powerful implants. Send your crew out to battle foes of human and alien origin, and meet many tactical objectives across a variety of terrain. Will you adapt and harness their true potential?
[/list]
If you’re primed for expanding your world and warding off impending doom, [b]make sure to try the new Demo out[/b]! And if you wish to learn more about the project — check out our Discord and Twitter!

Let us all live to see another day, together.

[url=https://discord.gg/7hSuXNCpMP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/ebfb28385d7b7db1c76c37beba67b2bdb184247f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Updated Demo OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Rise, the Ironlords![/h3]

The promised hour is at hand, for the first core update to the IRONHIVE Demo [b]has just been released[/b]!

This Demo version includes:
[list][*] [b]tutorial revamp[/b] to make it more sleek and accessible
[*] [b]numerous bug fixes[/b];
[*] [b]new supported languages[/b] and updates to the game’s [b]localization[/b][/list]
Thank you for your continuous feedback, which is making this possible so soon!

This new version of the Demo isn’t a one-off facelift either, as we are striving to constantly improve the experience for you. To that end, we’ve compiled a bug report form. [b]Please make sure to leave your feedback after giving the new Demo a go[/b]; this will be a great help in getting an even better Demo out to newcomers and improving the release version of the game while we’re at it.

[quote][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe7S22ZN9nOWpGPjcxi4pDHDlAQyJNBTApTlfV8k5MLjrekAw/viewform][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/b3ea71f305d0af6bebb208ba93f1ab501159905d.png[/img][/url][/quote]
[quote][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1O_3_twNFW7YunE_yUsq4Y6A15VUZ83M_DH3v6WqRozc/viewform][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/f0d72e07ad89bc6d5a1a27e122dce055f583733c.png[/img][/url][/quote]

As we take in your feedback and deal with the bug reports, we will start working on a new Demo build which will include brand-new mechanics, such as leaving your Hive for parts unknown and defending it from an outside force.

Speaking of feedback, you can also join our Discord server and discuss the game and its future there with your fellow Ironlords. Let’s join our forces and build this new world together.

We hope this new update lets you dive deeper into the world of IRONHIVE and share your experiences with others. See you all very soon!

notes.title: Thank you! + Changing Course
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Ironlords.[/h3]

We hope you have all been enjoying the IRONHIVE Demo, and this first look at the game got you excited for more things to come. For us as developers, releasing anything is also exciting, but unavoidably fraught with worry. However, we've been blown away by the positive reception from all of you. That energy will now fuel our motivation and keep us going the rest of the way. Thank you for taking the time to play the Demo and leave invaluable feedback.

We would also like to highlight content creators which spread the word about IRONHIVE at a time when it needed the spotlight the most. Special thanks goes to [i]Splattercatgaming[/i], [i]Wanderbots[/i], and [i]Retromation[/i], whose coverage of IRONHIVE helped keep it growing.

[previewyoutube=HO7YVgy315g;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HO7YVgy315g[/previewyoutube]
That said, we are aware that this release revealed some issues, most notable of which is the game’s tutorial, which could definitely use some improvement.

Our initial plan was to stop offering the Demo by June 16th. However, thanks to the feedback you had all shared and the warm reception we’d got, we decided to change our course of action.

[i][b]We will now be keeping the Demo up indefinitely and updating it[/b][/i] in accordance with your feedback and our vision. Here are the core updates you can expect to start seeing as early as July:
[h3][list]
[*] Continued improvements to the tutorial.
[*] More supported languages as well as updates to the existing localization.
[*] Continued bug-fixes.
[/list][/h3]And if you’d like to participate in future closed beta tests or just have the best place for providing feedback — [b]join our Discord[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/7hSuXNCpMP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/ebfb28385d7b7db1c76c37beba67b2bdb184247f.png[/img][/url]

As we deal with the more pressing updates, we will start [b]expanding the scope[/b] of what’s available in the Demo as well. No specific dates for now, but be prepared to venture outside of your IRONHIVE with the [b]Points of Interest[/b] update and defend your home from sinister [b]External Threats[/b]…

Ironlords, thank you for your continued support. You all deserve to spend more time in this world alongside us and see it grow together. With that, we are resuming work on the game and the Demo. 

See you all again very soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679070/IRONHIVE

[url=https://twitter.com/Ironhive_Game][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/2efe76e4ccc2d47aff6132a58bd8612f49c07429.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Demo is available NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, Ironlords!

IRONHIVE has been blessed to take part in the [b]Latin American Games Showcase[/b] — which is, amazingly, [b]a part of Summer of Games event this year[/b]! And just for the LAGS we've prepared a [b]brand new trailer showcasing the lore and gameplay[/b] — BEHOLD:

[previewyoutube=PdSZR4mq8Mo;full][/previewyoutube]
Yes, we've also released the first ever [b][u]public demo — which is available for you to play this very instant[/u][/b]! Experience the brutal harshness of IRONHIVE mechanics and narrative, and find solace in overcoming it's challenges. The world has crumbled... will you?

[quote][h3]DISCLAMER![/h3]
We have to step out of character to talk about something very important for a moment.

[h3]This demo will be available for a limited amount of time: 
from [b]June 8th till June 16th[/b] and will come back in [b]July[/b].[/h3]

If you would like to contribute to the development of the game and continue playing the demo after it is disabled, please [url=https://discord.gg/DFWbwST5eN][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url]. We will hold a closed beta access there.

Due to flooding happening in Brazil, we didn’t have enough time to polish the tutorial for IRONHIVE Demo. We would like to take some time to make your experience as the Ironlord unforgettable, which is why we are taking a step back to properly polish the demo. We apologize for the inconvenience of waiting a little longer before properly enjoying IRONHIVE.[/quote]

Back to the matters at hand, Ironlord. Here's what you can expect from the demo:
[list][*] [b]One full in-game year[/b] — Go through all four seasons with your colony and make every effort not to let it die out of hunger, lack of faith and or lawlessness;
[*] [b]Tutorial teachings[/b] — faithful associates will help you grasp the basics and lead the colony to a hopeful future, forged in iron;
[*] [b]Quests [/b]— fulfill the needs of the colony by following step-by-step tasks on the way to survival and efficiency;
[*] [b]Various Events[/b] — you will come across numerous events that can bring both ruin and prosperity;
[*] [b]All core in-game mechanics[/b] — try out every in-game feature in it's most fundamental form;
[*] [b]First tier of buildings for every caste[/b] — get accustomed not only to highly specialized castes of the hive but to the diversity of their features, needs and capabilities;
[*] … and, of course, feast on the striking visuals and ethereal soundtrack.
[/list]

However, don't leave just yet! We have a favor to ask in return...
Ironlords, [b]when you finish the demo, consider leaving your feedback by filling out this feedback form, by clicking this button[/b]:

[url=https://forms.gle/zPVrWXrSbTFjRJC18][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771554/1f93f52f157c5c39f5fb31095a243c20c5658d04.png[/img][/url]

Your feedback and opinions shall prove most useful in securing the bright future for IRONHIVE!

Thank you, for your support and continued interest in the game. Let us live to see another day, together.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[i]"And thus the prophesy was born:
Of blood, of iron, of ambition.
That with the Book of Ashes page's turn,
Only the strongest will survive perdition."[/i]
